Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #411 as item 2 of 3. The maintainer's filing words already lean: 「Company Core 共享本体放 objectstack 单仓」 — the card asks for the letter on the board and the namespace in the same breath. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `500bc9d5`):
- Premises hold: `packages/platform-objects/src` has no party/counterparty object (0 hits); `packages/apps/{account,setup,studio}` are the manifest-package shape under `packages/`; `RESERVED_NAMESPACES` in `objectql/src/registry.ts:400` holds `base` and `system`, and :1722 adds `sys` to the prohibition (the enforcement site the card left unverified — it exists); `manifest.zod.ts:531` names the three reserved namespaces; `checkDeclaredDependencies` lives in `cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` (ADR-0141 D2 live).
- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A puts the one shared ontology inside the platform PR's CI radius, consistent with ADR-0029's two tiers and ADR-0141 dependencies; B same end-state with an async canary; C widens `sys_*` against ADR-0029 D2/D4; D makes "customer" equal CRM's account forever. ② three apps already model the party three ways. ③ A/B refuse loudly at the install gate when the core is missing; C cannot refuse or uninstall; D multiplies the error surface. ④ A adds no key or gate.
- The seat agrees with **A** (fallback B), and recommends the namespace **`core`** / manifest id `com.objectstack.core` (objects `core_party`, `core_contact`, …): short, literal per ADR-0129, not reserved, and reads as what it is. Not C (ADR amendment to put business data in the kernel) and not D. Workload: server · 1 PR (package skeleton, manifest, default permission set, publish wiring) + 1 PR (CI install leg) · M; the object roster is a follow-up card after the maintainer reviews the proposed list.
Prior rulings read: ADR-0029 D2/D4, ADR-0141 D1/D2/D5/D7, ADR-0129, ADR-0019 D2; #25403; thread: none.

Ruled: closed as not planned · 2026-10-28T06:45Z

**Maintainer ruling** (this session, 2026-10-28, verbatim, not translated): 「所以 core 几乎没有价值了呀」 → 「26582 关卡」.

**What was decided.** None of the four options is taken. A shared Company Core is not built as a package at this stage. The value of a shared party (one "company" record for several apps installed in one environment) exists only for a customer running two or more products in one environment, and none exists today; the cost would fall on HotCRM (identity fields moved off `crm_account`, duplicate detection, import, MCP tools, reports re-pointed) and on three platform mechanisms that do not exist (record-page slot contributions from dependent packages, uninstall protection for dependents — ADR-0141 D3 deferred — and a conformance check of an unmanaged core). Under the North Star priority rule, work that is on no road step and in no checklist item is p3 or not done.

**What replaces it.** Core is demoted from a package to a convention: one page for AI authors naming the standard object shapes (party, contact, legal entity: names, minimal fields, identifiers as a typed registry rather than scattered fields, region-neutral rules, the names of the shared picklists). Each product writes its own objects to it; no table is shared. Cross-product references keep today's shape (ADR-0141 dependency plus a sync flow, as HotCLM's hand-off does). That convention page is a separate small card when the maintainer asks for it; it is not filed by this closure.

**Restart condition (for the record, not a hold):** the first paying customer that installs two products into one environment. Then party is promoted from convention to package and this question is re-opened with that customer's shapes as the premise.

**Side conclusions this thread settled, unrelated to the closure:** repositories split by product, not by market; a market is expressed as a distribution (a composition of product versions, region packs, a plugin set and a demo company), not as a merged repository; the China line starts with platform plugins (DingTalk / WeCom / Feishu channels, login, directory sync) before any second app.

Closed by `session_01J8VVAjRKqdoEYQ4hXxtBuf` on the maintainer's instruction. The director note 6439370659 recorded 「26582 交维护者处理」; this is that ruling. `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (triage 6437799530) was removed in the same stroke so the card leaves through one state.
